summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything I traced the full watchlist path (client fetch/save → auth middleware → `modules/watchlist` → DB) without implementing or editing anything. Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, I did **not** find: - a client-side localStorage/anonymous fallback for watchlists (only an unrelated theme preference uses localStorage), - a client-supplied or hardcoded watchlist ID, - a "get-or-create" path that could silently spin up a fresh empty watchlist per login/device, - any query that skips filtering by
